audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant is enforced by two complementary guards: (1) `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) asserts `!self.debts.contains(CoinType)` before adding collateral, blocking deposit of any already-borrowed asset; (2) `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) asserts `!self.ctokens.is_supporting_collateral<CoinType>()` on first borrow, blocking borrow of any already-collateralized asset. All collateral additions route through `deposit_ctoken` (sole caller: `handle_deposit` at market.move:294) and all debt additions route through `try_borrow_asset` (sole caller: `handle_borrow` at market.move:412); liquidation/ADL paths only reduce debt and collateral, never creating overlap.
